questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to walk home.
Only after the rain had stopped they began to walk home.
Only after the rain had stopped, they began to walk home.
Only after the rain had stopped; they began to walk home.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to walk home.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the discovery?
options: It was the old map that led them to the hidden treasure.
It was the old map which led them to the hidden treasure.
The hidden treasure was it that led them to the old map.
The hidden treasure was which led them to the old map.
questions.answer: It was the old map that led them to the hidden treasure.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly uses the third conditional to express a hypothetical situation in the past.
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would attend it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would be attending it.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.

questions.question: Which sentence accurately demonstrates the use of the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation?
options: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attends the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attending the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attended the meeting.
questions.answer: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.

questions.question: Identify the correctly formed sentence using ellipsis to omit the redundant part while maintaining grammatical coherence.
options: The team members who are responsible for the project are working late, as are the project manager.
The team members who are responsible for the project are working late, as is the project manager.
The team members who are responsible for the project are working late, as the project manager.
The team members who are responsible for the project are working late, as for the project manager.
questions.answer: The team members who are responsible for the project are working late, as are the project manager.
